artifact_identity: existing trusted local Docker bundle, not the original Stage4 binary
comparison: flatline vs ML on flatline targets; sustained_high vs ML on sustained_high targets; no cross-category aggregation; gap separate
matching: contiguous true episode onset inside inclusive event labels; no pre-existing/overlap-only credit; one-to-one; no post-event grace
availability: per-method flag nonnull; common mask for each rule/three ML/Unanimous comparison family; report all 6 events or all12 events including insufficient-coverage/missed events
signal_counts: episode onsets and flagged points separately, whole observed stream and event window, altered and raw paired stream
delay: source event-time minutes, detected events only; misses null; not processing latency
controls: single peak is not a sustained-high target; scheduled morning control has engineered historical energy profile; zero control is not a confirmed stuck meter
limitations: Historical UCI and already viewed dates, exploratory controlled comparison only
Artificial labels define manipulations/review situations, not real equipment failures
Positive and benign repeated constants can both trigger flatline
No parameter selection or model/threshold changes based on outputs
All24 cases retained; no resampling or post-result scenario replacement
